checked.found: Hippocrates c. 460-370 BCE; about 400 BCE is a fair approximate anchor for the Hippocratic school's clinical method.

Herophilus lived c. 335-280 BCE; -280 is his death year. Sources date his pulse work to the end of the 4th / early 3rd century BCE (c. 300 BCE) with no precise year. Britannica credits him with the water-clock pulse measurement; Karger attributes it to his teacher Praxagoras. Name and description otherwise fine.
checked.suggestion: Consider -300 if the deck wants his working period rather than his death.

checked.found: Sources only say the Maijing was compiled in the third century CE (Western Jin, 265-316); Britannica gives Wang c. 180-c. 270, some publishers say late Han. No source gives 280 specifically.

Santorio's 1612 Commentaria in artem medicinalem Galeni is cited as the first mention of an oral clinical thermoscope; Wikipedia cautions he wrote of a scaled version in 1625 and may have invented it as early as 1612. 1612 is the common date.
Red blood cells described 1674 by the Delft draper Leeuwenhoek.
Inventum novum published in Vienna in 1761.
Bozzini demonstrated the Lichtleiter in 1806 (Frankfurt-born German physician).
Riva-Rocci's cuff sphygmomanometer, 1896.
First human EEG recording 1924, published 1929; 1924 matches the claim 'recorded for the first time'.
Papanicolaou announced the cancer-cell finding in 1928; Greek-American.
Forssmann catheterised his own heart in 1929 and walked to the X-ray department.
Virginia Apgar devised the score in 1952 (published 1953).
Hirschowitz first used the fibre-optic gastroscope on a patient in 1957.
First clinical CT brain scan, Atkinson Morley Hospital, London, 1971.
Predictor home pregnancy test (test tube kit) launched 1976.
Damadian's 1977 whole-body scan of a man's chest.
First ELISA HIV antibody test licensed March 1985 and used to screen blood donations.
First human BOLD fMRI task studies published 1991-1992 (Kwong, Ogawa, Bandettini); 1992 is the usual date.
Iddan et al., 'Wireless capsule endoscopy', Nature 2000.
FDA cleared the Apple Watch Series 4 ECG app in September 2018.
Mass COVID-19 testing began in 2020.
